layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no compelling entry found, staying in cash for now.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market is in a fearful mood with most coins dropping over the past week. Bitcoin dominance is high at 56.3%, which means altcoins are getting hit harder than Bitcoin itself. Every candidate on our watchlist either has a bearish chart structure or is extremely overbought after a parabolic run. The smart move right now is to wait for a cleaner setup rather than force a trade into weakness.
layman_action: Stay patient and keep cash ready. Wait for either a deeper oversold bounce with chart confirmation, or a clear catalyst that shifts market sentiment. Don't chase falling knives in this environment.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all 9 candidates systematically. KAITO has a bullish chart (+1.10) but RSI at 87 is dangerously overbought — our signal credibility data shows RSI is 83% reliable, so this extreme reading strongly argues against entry. TRUMP and BONK have oversold RSI readings (27 and 29 respectively) which normally trigger bounce trades, but both have heavily bearish chart structures (-0.70 and -1.40) with price below all moving averages — catching a falling knife. FET and BONK both show bearish engulfing patterns, confirming seller control. ETH is the best risk-adjusted candidate with RSI at 41, above SMA20, and stable TVL, but the chart bias is -0.40 and risk/reward to nearest levels is only 0.84x. In a Fear environment with worsening trend and high BTC dominance crushing alts, the highest-EV play is to wait for a better entry. AAVE has a neutral RSI and slightly bullish chart but lacks any catalyst.
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 56.3% and rising continues to suppress altcoin performance across the board
Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening trend suggests further downside before capitulation bounce
Cold-wallet attack news ($89M losses) could trigger broader security concerns and sell pressure
watch_list: ETH price action at $1,800 support — a successful bounce with volume confirmation would trigger a BUY
Fear & Greed index — watch for extreme fear below 20 which historically marks short-term bottoms
BTC dominance trend — any reversal below 55% would signal rotation back into alts
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear-driven consolidation with BTC at $62.8K showing modest weakness (-2.5% weekly). High BTC dominance at 56.3% is crushing altcoin performance, and most top-20 tokens are red on the week, making this a poor environment for aggressive alt entries.
context_banner: Market fear persists with no clear reversal signal — disciplined patience outperforms forced entries in this environment.

key_signals.description: RSI readings across candidates are polarized: KAITO at 87 (dangerously overbought), TRUMP at 27 and BONK at 29 (oversold but in confirmed downtrends), ETH at 41 (approaching oversold but not there yet). No clean RSI bounce setup exists.

Fear & Greed at 27 with a worsening weekly trend from 27.9 to 27 — sentiment hasn't capitulated enough for a high-conviction contrarian entry. Our 67% win rate on this signal suggests waiting for extreme fear.

FET and BONK both show bearish engulfing candle patterns confirming seller dominance. KAITO shows Three White Soldiers but at RSI 87 this is a blow-off top risk, not an entry. No bullish reversal patterns at support levels.
Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spreading to 4,500 addresses with $89M losses creates negative sentiment overhang. Mining difficulty dropping 14% signals miner capitulation pressure on BTC price.
ETH derivatives reset noted by Blockworks could set up a cleaner bounce opportunity once positioning is flushed — worth monitoring for next cycle's entry timing.
